errors.faulty_justification: Candidate D is the only candidate that passes all critical requirements, including R03 (operating temperature range) and R06 (continuous current), while candidates A and B fail R03 and candidate C fails R01 and R03. Although R06 is marked unknown for D, the selection policy states that a candidate with an unknown critical result must not be selected unless no candidate passes all critical requirements; since no candidate passes all critical requirements, we prefer the candidate with the fewest critical failures. D has only one unknown critical result (R06), whereas A and B each have one critical failure (R03) and C has two critical failures (R01 and R03), so D has the fewest critical issues. Among the remaining candidates, applying the comparison criteria in priority order, D has the lowest unit price (159 EUR, satisfying K1) and the lowest mass (560 g, satisfying K2). Therefore, D is selected.
